prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 24 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1424; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with reported head impact and symptoms consistent with concussion. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are well matched to the reported presentation. Over the course of 24 visits, care followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved. Several examination findings support the diagnosis, while other neurological and cognitive screening results were within normal limits. The chart also documents prior treatment to the same body region within the past two years; that earlier condition appears to contribute to some of the current complaints and has been considered in the overall assessment. Billing records reviewed for this episode of care show no repeated or duplicate charges. Ongoing monitoring and symptom management are recommended, with follow-up as needed.
